tagline: AI-Powered Multilingual Emergency Triage and Offline Disaster Support System
hero_title: Lifesaving AI Triage in Any Language, Online or Offline
hero_subtitle: ResQAI connects citizens in distress with emergency coordinators, providing instant actionable safety instructions and reliable communication during floods, fires, earthquakes, and medical emergencies.
section_features_subtitle: Engineered with offline resilience, intelligent triage, and localized multi-channel emergency communication.
feature_ai_desc: Instantly analyzes incident descriptions, estimates urgency (Critical to Low), and generates immediate step-by-step safety guidance.
feature_multilingual_desc: Communicate naturally in Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu, Arabic, Spanish, French, and more with full RTL support.
feature_offline_desc: Queue emergency reports locally in IndexedDB when towers go down. Automatically synchronizes when connectivity is restored.
feature_broadcast_desc: Authorized emergency coordinators can dispatch geographically targeted or hazard-specific alerts with audited delivery tracking.
feature_responder_desc: Field responders receive prioritized incident queues, GPS coordinates, translations, and live operational status tracking.
feature_security_desc: Robust role-based access control, cryptographic password hashing, idempotency deduplication, and complete audit logging.
disclaimer_body: ResQAI is an auxiliary emergency assistance platform designed to triage requests and assist responders. It does NOT claim to replace government emergency services or telecommunication dispatchers. In any immediate life-threatening emergency, call 112 or your local emergency number immediately.
